limitations: Existing model-specific weight-class fallbacks are screening proxies; no payload, capacity, distance or unit correction is applied.
Native 3.5t uses the matching 3.5t IAM role in REMIND/REMIND-EU/TIAM-UCL/GCAM; IMAGE and WITCH retain the pre-existing nearest small-freight class fallback.

IAM regional fleet substitution replaces historical fuel, EURO and duty-cycle detail for these market purchases, as in the standard ecoinvent market relinking; this is not a claim of unchanged historical fleet composition.
Only complete fleet-average and independently reviewed converted market suppliers are aliases. Explicit dated/EURO producer services and municipal waste collection remain outside this market map.
Converted helper names are bound to packaged recipe signatures; closure changes require this alias review and its regression test to be updated.
